    Posterior draws of gene expression from a fitted brms model

    expression_draws.Rd

    Posterior draws of gene expression from a fitted brms model

    expression_draws(
  fit,
  newdata,
  quantity = c("linpred", "predict", "epred"),
  collapse = c("mean", "pool", "sample"),
  ndraws = NULL,
  transform = FALSE,
  re_formula = NULL,
  allow_new_levels = TRUE,
  sample_new_levels = "gaussian",
  seed = NULL
)

    Arguments

    fit

    A `brmsfit` or [load_expression_fit()] object.

    newdata

    Covariate grid from [build_newdata_grid()].

    quantity

    `"linpred"` (log μ), `"predict"`, or `"epred"`.

    collapse

    How to combine several grid rows: `"mean"`, `"pool"`, or `"sample"`.

    ndraws

    Number of posterior draws, or `NULL` for all.

    transform

    Passed to `posterior_linpred` only.

    re_formula, allow_new_levels, sample_new_levels

    Passed to brms.

    seed

    Optional RNG seed.

    Value

    A list with `draws`, `grid`, `quantity`, `collapse`, `n_grid`, `cell_type`, and `gene_ensg`.

    See also

    [expression_baseline_draws()], [build_newdata_grid()], [load_expression_fit()]
